newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen firm, but trade range limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen firm, but trade range limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to be firm on Monday, underpinned by steadiness in U.S. stocks on Friday and the dollar's stability above 115.00 yen.

But brokers said there were no issues that looked capable of leading a strong rally during the day, and this could limit Nikkei 225's trading range. On Monday, the 225-share Nikkei average lost 243.42 points, or 1.20 percent, to close at 20,068.81. June Nikkei futures fell 170 points to 20,140.
"Buying will continue to be seen in globally known blue chips, but trading range in the index might be limited," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
"Given the recent light trading volume, we can't expect large gains in the Nikkei 225," said a senior broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
On Friday, Dow industrials rose 0.86 point to close at 7331.04.
The dollar traded at around 116.00 yen in early Asian trade on Monday, against 116.32/42 yen in late Tokyo on Friday.
